description_excerpt: At Siemens Mobility, we enable our customers worldwide to realise sustainable mobility solutions. As a leading technology company, we combine the real and digital worlds like no other in rail. The Project Information Manager is responsible for establishing and maintaining consistent information management, data governance and reporting practices across the Vietnam High-Speed Rail project. You will play a key role in creating reliable project information, improving data quality and implementing digital and AI-enabled solutions to support effective project delivery.
